early_review.purpose: Assess initial signal strength and mechanism consistency
early_review.continue_criteria: IC > 0.005 AND mechanism consistent AND no data integrity issues

midpoint_review.purpose: Assess replication across slices and stability
midpoint_review.continue_criteria: IC stable across time windows AND universe consistency

stop_continue_review.continue_criteria: Sufficient evidence for evidence review gate

budget.justification: 20 experiments allows testing 4 horizons x 2 universes x 2 model classes x 1-2 feature variants with replication
